[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Medicine[COLOR_REVERT] allows you to construct the [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Hospital[COLOR_REVERT] city improvement, the [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Grand Hospitality Company[COLOR_REVERT] wonder and the [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Red Cross[COLOR_REVERT] national wonder. It enables the [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Environmentalism[COLOR_REVERT] civic.

[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Railroad[COLOR_REVERT] allows construction of [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Machine Gun[COLOR_REVERT] units. Most importantly, with [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Coal[COLOR_REVERT] or [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Oil[COLOR_REVERT] it allows your workers to upgrade your [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Roads[COLOR_REVERT] to [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Railroads[COLOR_REVERT], vastly increasing your units' movement.

[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Combustion[COLOR_REVERT] allows you to construct the [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Transport[COLOR_REVERT], [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Destroyer[COLOR_REVERT], and [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Attack Submarine[COLOR_REVERT] (with [COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Radio[COLOR_REVERT] and [COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Rocketry[COLOR_REVERT]) naval units. You may construct the [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Public Transportation[COLOR_REVERT] building. It enables your workers to build the [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Well[COLOR_REVERT] improvement on land-based [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Oil[COLOR_REVERT] resources and obsoletes the [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Whale[COLOR_REVERT] resource.

This technology allows construction of [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Broadcast Towers[COLOR_REVERT], as well as the [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Hollywood[COLOR_REVERT], [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]World Media Syndicate[COLOR_REVERT] and [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]United Nations[COLOR_REVERT] wonders.

[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Plastics[COLOR_REVERT] enables [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Work Boats[COLOR_REVERT] to construct [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Offshore Platforms[COLOR_REVERT]. It also lets you build [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Hydro Plants[COLOR_REVERT] and the [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Three Gorges Dam[COLOR_REVERT] wonder, and obsoletes [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Fur[COLOR_REVERT].

[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Refrigeration[COLOR_REVERT] allows construction of the [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Supermarket[COLOR_REVERT] building and the [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Continental Provisions Company[COLOR_REVERT] wonder. It also increases your water units' movement speed.

[COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Rocketry[COLOR_REVERT] allows you to build [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]SAM Infantry[COLOR_REVERT], [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Guided Missiles[COLOR_REVERT] and [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Attack Submarines[COLOR_REVERT] (with [COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Radio[COLOR_REVERT]), and [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]ICBMs[COLOR_REVERT] and [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Tactical Nukes[COLOR_REVERT] (with [COLOR_TECH_TEXT]Fission[COLOR_REVERT]). It enables the [COLOR_PROJECT_TEXT]Apollo Program[COLOR_REVERT].

Industry Supply Chains

[H1]Industry Supply Chains[\H1][NEWLINE][BOLD]How it works[\BOLD][NEWLINE]1. A local processing industry converts a raw resource into a synthetic trade good.[NEWLINE]2. Synthetic goods do not provide direct happiness or health by themselves.[NEWLINE]3. Connected synthetic goods unlock composite industries anywhere in your trade network.[NEWLINE]4. Composite industries turn off if their connected synthetic goods are lost.[NEWLINE]5. Corporations are founded from active composite sectors and powered by synthetic goods.[NEWLINE][BOLD]Luxury processing[\BOLD][NEWLINE]Dye Works: Dye -> Fine Dyes[NEWLINE]Furriers' Hall: Fur -> Fine Furs[NEWLINE]Jeweler's Quarter: Gems -> Cut Gems[NEWLINE]Minting House: Gold -> Gold Bullion[NEWLINE]House of Incense: Incense -> Temple Incense[NEWLINE]Ivory Carvers' Atelier: Ivory -> Ivory Carvings[NEWLINE]Silk Weaver's Workshop: Silk -> Fine Silk[NEWLINE]Silversmiths' Hall: Silver -> Worked Silver[NEWLINE]Spice Exchange: Spices -> Spice Blends[NEWLINE]Confectioners' Guild: Sugar -> Confections[NEWLINE]Vintners' Guild: Wine -> Vintage Wine[NEWLINE]Whale Oil Chandlery: Whale -> Lamp Oil[NEWLINE]Playwrights' Guild: Drama -> Stage Plays[NEWLINE]Recording House: Music -> Master Recordings[NEWLINE]Film Studio District: Movies -> Film Prints[NEWLINE][BOLD]Provision processing[\BOLD][NEWLINE]Millers' Guild: Wheat / Corn / Rice -> Flour[NEWLINE]Smokehouse: Cow / Pig / Sheep / Deer -> Cured Meats[NEWLINE]Cannery: Fish / Clam / Crab -> Preserved Seafood[NEWLINE]Fruit Preservers: Banana -> Fruit Preserves[NEWLINE][BOLD]Composite examples[\BOLD][NEWLINE]Royal Garments House: Fine Silk + Fine Dyes[NEWLINE]Crown Jeweler: Gold Bullion + Cut Gems[NEWLINE]Aromatics Quarter: Temple Incense + Spice Blends[NEWLINE]Grand Banquet Hall: Vintage Wine + Confections[NEWLINE]Bakers' Exchange: Flour + Spice Blends[NEWLINE]Royal Kitchens: Cured Meats + Vintage Wine[NEWLINE]Mass Entertainment Network: Stage Plays + Master Recordings + Film Prints[NEWLINE][BOLD]Icon note[\BOLD][NEWLINE]Synthetic goods use resource-style buttons with a gold star marker to show that they are processed goods rather than raw map bonuses.

[H1]Corporations[\H1][NEWLINE]Corporations now represent mature commercial sectors rather than raw-resource monopolies.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][BOLD]General Founding Rule[\BOLD][NEWLINE]To found a corporation, your team must know Corporations and the sector's own technology, your empire must operate at least three distinct active composite industries from that sector, and you must expend a Great Merchant to establish the headquarters.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][BOLD]Sector Requirements[\BOLD][NEWLINE]Continental Provisions Company: Refrigeration + any 3 of Bakers' Exchange, Spiced Carvery, Preserves Market, Victuallers' Exchange, Spiced Fish Market.[NEWLINE]Grand Hospitality Company: Medicine + any 3 of Festival Kitchens, Royal Kitchens, Grand Banquet Hall, Ceremonial Cellars, Maritime Supper Club, Pastry House, Dessert Cellars.[NEWLINE]Imperial Luxury Exchange: Banking + any 3 of Royal Garments House, Noble Tailors' Hall, Dyed Fur Salon, Crown Jeweler, Royal Mint, Gemcutters' Exchange.[NEWLINE]Courtly Arts & Regalia Consortium: Aesthetics + any 3 of Court Regalia Atelier, Regal Treasures Court, Imperial Outfitters, Admiralty Curios House, Navigators' Instrument Works, Hall of Cameos, Triumphal Court, Gallery of Antiquities, Curio Auction House.[NEWLINE]Aromatics & Festival Consortium: Drama + any 3 of Perfumers' Quarter, Confectioners' Exchange, Festival Market, Perfumed Salon, Lantern Procession Works, Sacred Precinct.[NEWLINE]World Media Syndicate: Mass Media + any 3 of Opera House, Cinema Palace, Soundstage Complex, Mass Entertainment Network, Illuminated Theatre.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][BOLD]Operation[\BOLD][NEWLINE]Once founded, corporations scale from connected synthetic goods such as Flour, Gold Bullion, Marble Statuary, Temple Incense, or Stage Plays. Synthetic goods remain tradable and can activate or deactivate composite industries and corporate value when trade access changes.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][BOLD]Spread[\BOLD][NEWLINE]A corporation may spread only to cities with relevant connected synthetic inputs, using sector-specific executive units and the normal gold spread cost.
